svg.title: Field Recordings, Great Salt Lake. 12-inch LP

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: A 12-inch record of ten sounds from one Salt Lake winter, recorded on location and left alone.
The sleeve is an aerial of the Spiral Jetty in the pink north arm. The disc is poured pink over blue at the causeway angle.

Recorded by [Recordist], winter 2026. Mastered for vinyl in Salt Lake.
Sleeve after Robert Smithson, Spiral Jetty, 1970, with the Holt/Smithson Foundation.
Visit Salt Lake. VSL 001. 180 gram, 33 1/3 rpm.

svg.text: Every disc pours a little differently, so every copy is a slightly different lake. The recordist is credited

text.font-family: 'Ivar Display', 'Ivar Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: on the front and the back of every pressing. The sleeve is printed on reverse board, so the pink sits matte and chalky.
